report.title: Derelict Payload conveyors do not save current payload
report.body:
### Platforms

Windows

### Build

release build 159.3

### Issue

derelict payload conveyors lose their current payload (blocks) after restarting the map or reloading the save

(originally this was a suggestion to rework payload conveyors, but I decided to issue this as a bug instead)

### Steps to reproduce

1.) Place block on payload conveyor and make sure it's derelict
2.) Save game
3.) Load game
4.) See results

### Mods used

_No response_

### Save file

[mindustry-data-export.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29970021/mindustry-data-export.zip)

### (Crash) logs

_No response_

summary: Could not complete a save/load reproduction. A new controlled editor map was created with a Sharded core, Payload Source, and Payload Conveyor, but no block payload was configured or observed on the conveyor, no Derelict conversion was completed, and no save/load transition was performed.

spec.summary: Reported loss of the current block payload from derelict payload conveyors after saving and then loading/restarting a map in Mindustry build 159.3.
spec.observed_behavior: The reporter states that derelict payload conveyors lose their current payload (blocks) after restarting the map or reloading a save.
spec.expected_behavior: A block currently carried by a derelict payload conveyor should remain present after the relevant map restart or save reload, if that state is intended to persist.
known_preconditions: A payload conveyor is in a derelict state.
A block payload is placed on that conveyor.
Reporter supplied a linked archive named mindustry-data-export.zip.
uncertain_conditions: Whether the behavior occurs specifically after loading a saved game, restarting a map, or both; the report groups these scenarios together.
Whether the conveyor must be naturally generated derelict terrain content versus a player-placed conveyor made derelict.
How the conveyor is made or confirmed to be derelict.
Which payload block types are affected and whether all block payloads reproduce the result.
Whether payload position, payload contents, conveyor configuration, nearby blocks, or map type affect reproduction.
Whether the issue reproduces without mods; the Mods used field received no response rather than an explicit no-mod confirmation.
Whether the supplied archive contains the affected save, map, configuration, and/or other relevant data.
Whether the target commit exactly corresponds to the reported release build 159.3.
Whether the behavior reproduces on Linux; Linux is only listed as planned evaluation, not as a reported affected platform.
Whether payload persistence for derelict conveyors is intended behavior; no authoritative expected behavior or specification was provided.
reproduction_hints: On Windows using the reported build, create or open a map containing a derelict payload conveyor.
Place a block payload onto the conveyor and verify that it is currently carrying the payload before saving.
Save the game, then load that save and inspect the conveyor's payload.
Separately test a map restart/reload workflow, since the report does not distinguish it clearly from save loading.
If the supplied archive is available, inspect it for a save or map that preserves the reporter's setup.
required_artifacts: The linked mindustry-data-export.zip archive, including confirmation of its contents and extraction status.
The exact affected save file and, if separate, the map file.
A minimal reproduction map or precise setup details for creating a derelict payload conveyor.
Game logs from the save and load session, if available.
Confirmation of the installed build identifier/version and whether it matches target commit 2c066e9c8c7e153e4eb91d730ead02e9011edd75.
A mod list or explicit confirmation that no mods were enabled.
Before/after screenshots or a video showing the payload on the conveyor before saving and absent after load.
Details of the exact reload path used: load save, restart map, return to menu and reload, or another workflow.

hypotheses.statement: A block payload carried by a derelict payload conveyor is not retained across a local save/load cycle.
hypotheses.prediction: After visibly loading a payload onto a conveyor assigned to the Derelict team, saving, and loading that save, the same conveyor will be empty.
hypotheses.observation: I created a controlled editor map and placed a Sharded core, Payload Source, and Payload Conveyor, but the session time limit arrived before I could configure the source, visibly load a block payload, switch the conveyor to Derelict, and execute a save/load cycle.
